audioNote.markdown: Welcome to Sessionboard! In this tutorial, we’ll guide you through the simple steps to create a contact for your event. Contacts can be assigned to sessions as speakers, moderators, chairpersons, or session submitters. They can also be linked to sponsor and exhibitor groups as group contacts.

steps.title: Create A Contact

audioNote.markdown:
To start, navigate to the Contacts module on the left-hand menu. This is where you can manage all your event contacts, including speakers, moderators, and more.

To add a new contact, simply click the Add button to the right of your screen.

steps.title: Contact Adding

audioNote.markdown: Note: You can also add contacts through the Speakers module. However, once created, the contact will only be accessible in the Contacts module until they are assigned to a session as a speaker. After the assignment, the contact will appear in the Speakers module.

steps.title: Speaker Adding

audioNote.markdown: In the pop-up window, you can search for an existing contact across your organization by name or email to add them to your event. In addition, you can search to ensure the contact does not already exist within your event. This helps avoid duplicates and keeps your data organized.

steps.title: Search Existing Contact

audioNote.markdown: If the contact already exists within your organization, you can easily add them to your event by checking the box next to their name and clicking the Add to Event button at the bottom of the pop-up.

steps.title: Add Existing Contact

audioNote.markdown: If the contact you are searching for does not already exist, simply select the Add new contact button to create the contact.

steps.title: Add New Contact

audioNote.markdown: Fill in the required contact details, including email, first name, and last name. You may also add optional information such as job title, company name, and phone number if available. If you don’t have these details right away, that’s okay—you can request additional information from the contact through the portal or update their profile at a later time. Once you are done, don't forget to click the save button.
